blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Masungi Georeserve in Rizal said the “pressure” to preserve what is left of “our forests” is intensifying as threats continue to change. It raised the concern as it reiterated data from the World Resources Institute (WRI), which revealed “a troubling shift in the drivers of intact forest landscape loss.” “At Masungi, we see how difficult it is to restore a forest—and how quickly years of patient work can be undone,” it said, stressing that “every surviving tree represents years of care, protection, and vigilance.” Since the 2000s, the Masungi Georeserve Foundation (MGF) has conserved and rehabilitated the […]...
